output.population: 93 patients with idiopathic PD (mean age: 66.3 years; 63% men) and 73 healthy controls (mean age: 66.3 years; 55% men).
output.summary: Gait measures from patients with idiopathic Parkinson's disease and healthy controls, recorded as vertical ground reaction forces while walking at a self-selected pace on level ground for about two minutes.
